do_not_use_when: Deriving rules from an existing FeynRules model: use model-derivation-bridge.
Validating a supplied UFO: use model-tool-bridge or model-ward.

examples.phrase: Author a FeynRules model from a typed specification and check its UFO.

Lint, gauge-check and export a UFO of a new model.
